text: Chronicle demonstrates registering GuidSerializer(GuidRepresentation.Standard) alongside IgnoreExtraElementsConvention(true), and advises adding CamelCaseElementNameConvention only when its naming policy is configured for camel case. (low confidence)

text: Configure binary GUIDs explicitly. A common startup configuration is BsonSerializer.RegisterSerializer(new GuidSerializer(GuidRepresentation.Standard)); use BsonGuidRepresentation attributes for properties requiring a different representation. Chronicle independently demonstrates the same global Standard serializer configuration. (high confidence)
keywords: C#/.NET driver serialization conventions and GUID representation

text: An unspecified binary GUID representation is an error: GuidSerializer throws BsonSerializationException when asked to serialize or deserialize binary GUIDs with GuidRepresentation.Unspecified. (low confidence)
keywords: C#/.NET driver serialization conventions and GUID representation

text: The serializer registry is global to the application, and MongoDB documents that multiple serializer registries cannot be used in one application. Register custom serializers before their use. (low confidence)

text: Register naming conventions by placing CamelCaseElementNameConvention in a ConventionPack and passing the pack to ConventionRegistry.Register; this changes serialized field names to camel case without decorating each member. (high confidence)
keywords: C#/.NET driver serialization conventions and GUID representation

text: EnumRepresentationConvention selects enum storage representation; IgnoreExtraElementsConvention controls whether deserialization ignores extra document elements. These are separate serialization choices. (low confidence)
keywords: C#/.NET driver serialization conventions and GUID representation

text: GUID subtype 3 did not standardize byte order across drivers. Standard maps to subtype 4; CSharpLegacy, JavaLegacy and PythonLegacy map to subtype 3 with different byte orders. MongoDB recommends subtype 4 for new GUID data. (low confidence)
keywords: C#/.NET driver serialization conventions and GUID representation

text: For mixed historical representations across properties, combine a global GuidSerializer with BsonGuidRepresentation attributes on exceptional properties. The upgrade guide advises checking existing GUID representations before introducing a global serializer. (high confidence)
keywords: C#/.NET driver serialization conventions and GUID representation

text: The version 3.0 migration supports only GuidRepresentationMode.V3 semantics. BsonBinaryData(Guid) and BsonBinaryData.GuidRepresentation were removed; parameterless BsonBinaryData.ToGuid() is limited to subtype 4, while other representations require ToGuid(GuidRepresentation). (low confidence)
keywords: C#/.NET driver serialization conventions and GUID representation

text: Convention packs apply serialization rules without decorating every class. Register a ConventionPack through ConventionRegistry.Register(); the documented t => true predicate applies the pack to all types. (medium confidence)
keywords: C#/.NET driver serialization conventions and GUID representation

text: Built-in conventions cover camel-case element names, enum representation, ignoring extra document elements during deserialization, and allowed types for ObjectSerializer. (low confidence)
keywords: C#/.NET driver serialization conventions and GUID representation

text: The serializer registry is global to the application. ObjectSerializer accepts an allowed-type predicate; the documentation demonstrates extending ObjectSerializer.DefaultAllowedTypes with explicitly permitted custom types and requires registering ObjectSerializer at program startup. (low confidence)
keywords: C#/.NET driver serialization conventions and GUID representation

The response attributed this to stored legacy GUID values and advised matching the default or property-specific representation; the official guide separately documents legacy byte orders and per-property configuration. (medium confidence)
